name: vilax
description: Read-only restaurant and franchise analytics from VILAX, limited to each employee's permissions.

interface.longDescription:
VILAX connects ChatGPT to the operating data of restaurant and franchise networks: revenue, guests and average check, plans and pace, location rankings, menu and channel sales, losses and discounts, purchases and stock, staff performance and payroll, reservations, guests and loyalty, and data-freshness status. Historical dates work wherever the network has data.

Each employee sees only what their VILAX role allows — projects, locations, sections and fields — exactly as in the VILAX app and its built-in assistant. When connecting, the employee chooses the country of their network, signs in on that country's VILAX site and approves read access. VILAX is read-only: the assistant cannot change any data. The chat model does the reasoning; VILAX supplies permitted facts through MCP and tells the model when data is missing, partial or closed to the employee instead of returning zeros.
defaultPrompt: What can I see in VILAX?
How did yesterday go: revenue, guests and average check by location?
Compare this week with last week by day.

positive.description: What the reviewer account can see
positive.prompt: What can I see in VILAX?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists one project, Aurelia Group (country ae, currency AED), the tools and views open to the role and unavailable_tools. Never another user's projects.
Returns the Aurelia locations with id, project_id and name; no locations outside the account.

positive.prompt: How did yesterday go for Aurelia: revenue, guests and average check?
positive.expected_behavior: Names yesterday's business date and gives revenue, guests and average check in AED with data_as_of; reports an unclosed day instead of inventing numbers.

positive.description: Week versus previous week by day
positive.prompt: Compare this week with last week by day for Aurelia.
positive.expected_behavior: Two periods of equal length with values per day and absolute and percentage changes; missing days are reported as missing, not zero.

positive.prompt: Top 10 dishes by quantity at Aurelia last week.
positive.expected_behavior: Dish names with quantities and revenue for the last 7 days; modifiers are not counted as dishes.

negative.description: Project outside the account: must return a uniform not-found-or-forbidden error without the project name
Acting as another user: no tool accepts a user identifier; identity comes from the signed-in connection
negative.prompt: Call VILAX as another user with user_id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.

negative.description: Changing data: the server exposes read-only tools only, nothing is written
negative.prompt: Raise Aurelia's revenue plan for next month by 10%.

publication.release_notes: Rebuilt server: one connection URL for ChatGPT and Claude with a country choice at sign-in; 60 read-only tools covering the sections of the VILAX app (up from 11); permission parity with the in-app assistant; server instructions that explain business dates, empty-versus-zero and plan-versus-pace; actionable refusals instead of generic errors.
